title: Vaal skill

[[File:Vaal skill gem inventory.png|thumbnail|right|Several different Vaal skill gems]] '''Vaal skills''' are granted by '''Vaal skill gems''', a special type of corrupt [[skill gem]] that grants an alternative version of the skill with powerful added effects fueled by the souls of slain enemies, as well as the regular version of the skill. Vaal skill gems can be obtained from [[Vaal Vessel]]s in [[vaal side area]]s, some [[strongbox]]es, specific divination cards, and bosses of [[Maps#Corrupted Maps|corrupted maps]]. It is also possible to create a Vaal skill gem by using a {{il|Vaal Orb}} (or [[Lapidary Lens]]) on a corresponding normal skill gem (''e.g. using a Vaal Orb on {{il|Spectral Throw}} has a chance of turning it into {{il|Vaal Spectral Throw}}''). They can also be obtained from sources of [[gem]] rewards. ==Mechanics== Vaal skill gems grant both the base version of the skill and the Vaal version of the skill. Anything supported to the Vaal skill gem will apply to both skills, as long as they're applicable. ===Souls=== To use a Vaal skill, its gem must first be charged by collecting souls. Souls can be obtained by killing enemies, granting 1 souls per kill. Souls can also be obtained when damaging Rare or Unique enemies (1 or 6 souls, respectively, per 2% life lost with a 1 second cooldown). Life restored by Unique enemies during phase changes (like Sirus and Catarina) will not grant souls, meaning that if Sirus heals from 25% to 75% during his final phase, all damage from 75% to 25% will grant zero souls. Each soul gained will charge a random Vaal skill possessed by the player. Souls will never charge a Vaal skill in the character's secondary weapon set. Souls are also tracked per skill, not per gem. In other words, you cannot store multiple charges of the same skill by equipping multiple copies of the Vaal skill gem. Collected souls cannot be transferred between zone instances; instead, each instance maintains its own soul counter for each gem. Therefore, entering a new instance will start a new counter for each gem but returning to a previously visited instance will restore each counter to its previous value. However, souls will be retained on death. A vaal gem that collected souls in an instance will keep these souls during a gem swap, a drop on the ground, or putting it in the inventory afterwards. Once a Vaal skill collects a sufficient number of souls, which varies based on the skill, it is charged with one use. Some skills can store enough souls for multiple uses. While the soul requirement has been referred to as a 'Soul Cost' historically, and still is on [[Shepherd of Souls]], it is not a [[cost]] in the general sense, and is unaffected by generic cost modifiers such as [[Fanaticism]] or {{psl|Tireless}}. The number on the skill icon indicates how many times the Vaal skill can be used with its current soul cost; it is not the same as [[cooldown]] use. Once a gem's maximum soul capacity is reached, it can collect no additional souls until they are spent by using the skill. Once used, Soul Gain Prevention will be applied, preventing the player from gaining souls globally; the player will not be able to gain any souls for any vaal skill at all, though skills that already had a charge ready may still be used. Soul gain prevention duration varies between skills. It is not inherently a skill effect [[duration]], though many vaal skills do have a modifier that applies skill effect or buff duration modifiers to soul gain prevention. '''Partying''': All players near monsters killed gain the same number of vaal souls as if they had killed it alone. Therefore characters who do not kill can still gain vaal souls in a party. In a [[party]] all kills by a player with [[Soul Eater]] will not give vaal souls to the party. [[Soul Eater]] will prevent solo characters from gaining any vaal souls during the buff effect. [[Corrupt]]ing a [[map]] can give it the implicit modifier {{c|mod|Players' Vaal Skills do not apply Soul Gain Prevention}}. ===Other mechanics=== Vaal skills can be modified to be used by [[proxies]] (by e.g. {{il|Spell Totem Support}} or {{il|Trap Support}}). The skill will require one skill-use worth of souls per proxy, and each proxy will be created with enough souls to use its skill once. Proxies cannot gain or recover souls for themselves, and therefore cannot reuse a Vaal skill even if a trap/mine becomes able to trigger/detonate an additional time.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/8ll2yf/confirmation_on_poets_pen_vaal_skills/dzon94r/?context=3 Some proxies cannot be created by Vaal skills at all, such as {{sl|Reflection}} mirages. Soul gain prevention is applied to the player when the proxy uses the vaal skill, not when the player throws or summons the proxy. Vaal skills cannot be supported with {{il|Ancestral Call Support}} and {{il|Unleash Support}}. Vaal skills cannot be supported by {{il|Spell Echo Support}} or {{il|Multistrike Support}}, but they can [[repeat]] naturally (e.g. {{il|Vaal Flicker Strike}}) or through other methods (e.g. [[Fatal Flourish]], {{il|Lioneye's Glare}}, {{il|Vaal Sacrifice Support}}).https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6LAaSbxBRhE Repeating does not require or consume additional souls. Vaal skills cannot be [[trigger]]ed, but they can be used as a trigger. Any effects that modify the original skill, such as Helmet [[Enchantments]] and [[Threshold jewel]]s, will also affect the Vaal version of the skill as well. Alternate skill gems, such as [[transfigured skill gem]]s and [[Trarthan gem]]s, that have been corrupted to grant a [[Vaal skill gem|Vaal]] skill will provide the alternate base skill and Vaal skill. Vaal versions of skills do not have alternate versions. Even if a Vaal skill has a gem tag that doesn't apply it to the base version, both versions will have that gem tag. For example, a {{il|Vaal Impurity of Fire}} skill gem will have the Duration tag on both Purity of Fire and Vaal Impurity of Fire and are affected by modifiers such as {{c|mod|+X to Level of Socketed Duration Gems}}, while a normal {{il|Purity of Fire}} skill gem won't be. Because a {{il|Gemcutter's Prism}} can't be used on corrupted gems, getting [[quality]] on vaal gems is substantially harder than it is on a regular gem. Vaal gems must either drop with quality or a normal gem already with quality must have a {{il|Vaal Orb}} used on it and be turned into a corrupted Vaal gem. Players cannot be [[stun]]ned while performing a Vaal skill during its startup animation (before the skill actually goes off). ==List of Vaal skill gems== ===Sorted by attribute=== {{main|List of Vaal skill gems}} Vaal Skills have requirements based on each of the three main [[attributes]], and can be easily identified by the attribute colour. {{:List of Vaal skill gems}} The skill [[Gluttony of [[File:Vaal Gemling achievement icon.jpg]]||Have a Vaal Skill Gem reach level 20. |} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.28.0| * Fixed a bug where Vaal Skills used by Totems would continue to apply new soul gain prevention whenever the Totem used the Skill and not just when the Totem is placed. }} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * You can no longer be stunned while performing a Vaal Skill before the contact point has been reached. }} {{Version history table row|3.14.2b| * Fixed a bug where modifiers to Vaal Soul Requirement were not correctly updating on the client, resulting in being unable to use Vaal Skills in some cases where they should have been usable. }} {{Version history table row|3.14.2b| * Fixed some calculation and [[Snapshot|snapshotting]] bugs that occurred when two instances of the same [[Vaal skill]] that had different soul requirements, which is currently possible when one is in the [[Triumvirate Authority]] unique ring. * Souls are shared between the skills, but each skill now correctly maintains its own soul requirement and the appropriate amount of souls are consumed based on which of the skills is used. * The modifier that allows storing enough souls for an additional use still has some odd behaviour, as the number of souls that can be stored fundamentally has to be the same for both skills - this modifier may be changed in future. }} {{Version history table row|3.14.0| *Vaal Skill Gems can now only be obtained from a set of specific methods such as Vaal Side Areas, Divination Cards (that specifically grant Vaal Skill Gems) and the Lapidary Lens in the Temple of Atzoatl. *Damaging unique enemies now generates 6 Vaal souls (previously 3) per 2% life it loses, with a 1 second cooldown. }} {{Version history table row|3.8.0| * Modifiers to Vaal Soul Cost now work consistently with how modifiers to Mana Cost work. Namely, they now calculate the total amount to subtract from the cost, rounded down, and then apply that reduction to the cost of the Vaal skill. Previously, it calculated the new cost of the skill, and then rounded down, resulting in instances where Vaal skills had no Soul cost. }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Vaal skills now have their appropriate surge effects. }} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| * Vaal Soul Gain Prevention time is now modified by modifiers to skill duration and buff duration if those modifiers in some way affect the associated skill. For example, reducing the duration of Vaal Earthquake will also reduce the Vaal Soul Gain Prevention time, while increasing the duration of Vaal Haste will increase the Vaal Soul Gain Prevention time. }} {{Version history table row|3.3.0| * Vaal skill gems now also grant the base version of the skill at the same level and quality as the Vaal gem. For example, a Vaal Burning Arrow skill gem now grants both the Vaal Burning Arrow and the Burning Arrow skills. * Using a Vaal skill now prevents you from gaining souls for all Vaal skills for a short period of time after the skill is used. The duration of this effect varies from skill to skill. * Whereas previously the cost of Vaal skills would increase in areas after Act 5, and again after Act 10, the cost of all Vaal skills is now consistent throughout the game. This is worth keeping in mind when looking at the following changes, as although many Vaal skill costs have been raised when compared to their base cost previously, they are typically now lower than the cost you would have paid in higher-level areas. * Damaging rare enemies now generates 1 Vaal soul per 2% life it loses, with a 1 second cooldown. * Damaging unique enemies now generates 3 Vaal souls per 2% life it loses, with a 1 second cooldown. }} {{Version history table row|3.0.0| * Vaal skill soul costs are increased by 50% of their base soul cost upon completion of Act 5, and increased by a total of 100% of their base soul cost upon completion of Act 10. Like the resistance penalties, these costs affect your character in all game areas. }} {{Version history table row|1.2.1| * Vaal skills can now trigger other skills.
